title: SLA sweep
prompt: Our urgent tickets are slipping. Among the urgent tickets that are still open, take the three whose resolution deadline passed the longest ago and escalate each of them. Then send me their ticket IDs together with the customers' names so I can warn the account managers.

calls.args: {"ticket_id":"T-1717","reason":"Urgent ticket long past resolution deadline (due 2026-03-25); escalating for review."}
{"ticket_id":"T-1227","reason":"Urgent ticket long past resolution deadline (due 2026-03-26); escalating for review."}
{"ticket_id":"T-0931","reason":"Urgent ticket long past resolution deadline (due 2026-04-02); escalating for review."}

agent_text.text:
I escalated the three urgent tickets in `open` status whose resolution deadline passed longest ago. Each is now at escalation level 1.

| Ticket | Customer | Resolution was due |
|---|---|---|
| T-1717 | Marcus Roberts | 2026-03-25 |
| T-1227 | Dana Richardson | 2026-03-26 |
| T-0931 | Reginald Padilla | 2026-04-02 |

- **Scope:** I read "still open" as status `open` only. If you meant every unresolved ticket, including `pending` and `new`, the list changes. T-1929 (due 2026-03-06) and T-1541 (due 2026-03-04) are both `pending` and older than all three above. I haven't escalated those.
- **Assignees:** Escalating didn't change who owns each ticket. The assignees are still A-0033 (T-1717), A-0036 (T-1227) and A-0018 (T-0931).
- **Priority:** The tickets were already urgent, so the priority stayed the same. The escalation reason is saved as an internal note on each ticket.
